title: [review] tx_queue.py:416: `confirm_transmitted()` does n
description: The `confirm_transmitted()` method calls `_remove_first()` which updates transmission stats but never calls `reservation.set_result()`. If a packet was pushed with `return_reservation=True` and later transmitted via the `peek()`/`confirm_transmitted()` flow, callers awaiting the reservation will hang indefinitely since the Future is never resolved.
close_reason: Fixed: _remove_first() now signals reservation.set_result(True) so confirm_transmitted() flow no longer leaves callers hanging
